links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of ChatGPT responses versus eighth-grade target
links.effect: All 19 responses exceeded the eighth-grade reading level by an average of 5.91 grade levels.
links.quote: Readability analysis showed all 19 responses exceeded the eight-grade reading level by an average of 5.91 grade levels.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education responses relative to patient comprehension
links.effect: All 19 responses exceeded the eighth-grade reading level by an average of 5.91 grade levels; complexity may limit usefulness for lower health literacy.
links.quote: While it may support patient understanding, the complexity of its responses may limit usefulness for individuals with lower health literacy.

links.outcome: Surgeon-rated accuracy of ChatGPT answers to patient questions on spinal deformity surgery
links.effect: 59.7% excellent, 26.3% satisfactory, 12.3% moderate clarification needed, 1.8% unsatisfactory; one response (pain return/worsening) rated inaccurate by all reviewers.
links.quote: 59.7% of responses were excellent (no clarification needed), 26.3% were satisfactory (minimal clarification needed), 12.3% required moderate clarification, and 1.8% were unsatisfactory, with one response ("Will my pain return or worsen?") rated inaccurate by all reviewers.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates ChatGPT-3.5's accuracy and readability on common preoperative adult spinal deformity surgery questions, but it evaluates the base model alone without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
